subject: about the error in scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model = "binary") : )

messages.author: d3c445ee99455fe8
messages.subject: about the error in scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model = "binary") : )
parts:
Dear r/qtl2 group,
    I am trying to use qtl2 to analyze my data(cc mice). When I was trying to perform a genome scan with binary traits, the error showed like this:
Error in scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model = "binary") : No individuals in common.
   When I was viewing "bin_pheno" , it showed NA;NA;NA...
    Previously, it worked well.
    Thanks for your help! I really appreciate it!
                 Chenhan
Here are my script in R. 
library(qtl2)
message("Write control file")
write_control_file("~/RStudio/RawData/cc_aom/cc_aom.json", crosstype = "risib8",
                   geno_file="cc_aom_geno.csv",
                   founder_geno_file="cc_foundergeno_1_X.csv",
                   pheno_file="cc_aom_pheno.csv",
                   pheno_transposed=FALSE,
                   gmap_file="cc_gmap_1_X.csv", 
                   pmap_file="cc_pmap_1_X.csv",
                   crossinfo_file="cc_aom_crossinfo.csv",
                   covar_file="cc_aom_covar.csv",
                   sex_covar="Sex",
                   sex_codes=list(male="male",female="female"),
                   xchr="X",
                   geno_codes=c("A"=1, "B"=3),
                   alleles=LETTERS[1:8],
                   geno_transposed=TRUE,
                   founder_geno_transposed=TRUE,
                   description=paste("Data for Collaborative Cross (CC) lines",
                                     "combine with memory data"),
                   overwrite=TRUE)

# create zip file
message("Create zip file")
zip_datafiles("~/RStudio/RawData/cc_aom/cc_aom.json", overwrite=TRUE)
# read data
cc <- read_cross2("~/RStudio/RawData/cc_aom/cc_aom.zip")

# Calculating a kinship matrix
# Calculating genotype propabilities
map <- insert_pseudomarkers(cc$gmap, step=1)
# use calc_genoprob() to calculate the QTL genotype probabilities.
pr <- calc_genoprob(cc, map, error_prob=0.002)
# convert genotype  probabilities to allele probabilities
apr <- genoprob_to_alleleprob(pr)
# Calculating a kinship matrix
kinship <- calc_kinship(pr)

#Performing a genome scan with binary traits
bin_pheno <- apply(cc$pheno, 2, function(a) as.numeric(a > median(a)))
rownames(bin_pheno) <- rownames(cc$pheno)
#perform the genome scan as before, model="binary"
out_bin <- scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model="binary")
#Error in scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model = "binary") : No individuals in common.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] about the error in scan1(pr, bin_pheno, model = "binary") : )
parts:
bin_pheno is missing names. If it's a matrix, add rownames. If it's just
a vector, add names.

But note that I strongly recommend about converting quantitative traits
to binary in this way. There's a great loss of information.

karl
